items.title: Zeke Mullins interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, New York, June 9, 2017
items.q: I would call him a genius. I would go that far.

ctx.x: I’ll tell you, at first, when I first heard him, I kind of stepped back, damn, man. Just like a lot of other people. But he was the master of his fate. He knew his music, and he played his music. I would call him a genius. I would go that far. There’s so many tunes that he composed man that were hell of a jazz tune, and they’ll be around a long time. They’ll be played a long time.
So in the last twenty or thirty years for you, do you mostly wait for the phone to ring as far as gigs?
